payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: the props role table on master (src/native/props/roles.rs @ e98c7fe9, also origin/master) classifies every area/project bookkeeping key as loose, although the plan asks to 'audit bob's frontmatter writers to complete this list'. Missing derived keys: done_tasks (written by bob task archive; on 11 areas and 42 projects); project status (bob projects sync mirrors ^prj: checked→done, canceled→canceled, reopen→wip); leftover frontmatter scheduled on projects (projects sync hoists it onto ^prj); template (written by capture_project_note.rs:562, never read); task_count/open_task_count (written by the bob-project-tasks plugin, see bob-cli-pi). Impact: =+ on any area/project note would offer free-text edits of done_tasks (breaking archive pairing) and status: done on an open project (silently reverted by the next projects sync). Evidence: research:202611/area_project_property_cards__cld.md §1.4–§1.5, §5.5 (file:explicit:a4873a8805c572a2cd19068c).

Verified: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features with just-check deny gates; cargo test --lib native::props (49 passed, including golden inverse/redo). epic-symbols: none. Host just check is the remaining gate.

payload.entry: LAND FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (complete before repair proposal): Read every note on all three phases. bob-cli-pf.2.1.1 #2 (capture-related performance gate) corroborated bob-cli-bo with attributed ToolRun pass/fail evidence; no duplicate task. bob-cli-pf.2.1.2 #2 (two gcal_ack session tests using fixed sleeps) created small task bob-cli-pk and marked ready after all-status duplicate searches, the last-week task sweep, and active-epic causal review. bob-cli-pf.2.1.3 #1 (Spotify/gmail_transport ETXTBSY executable stubs) corroborated bob-cli-5l with attributed phase evidence and current source locations; no duplicate task. Declined treating ETXTBSY as the same defect as the gcal_ack timing failures: stub executable descriptor races and fixed input/journal deadlines need different remedies. No active epic has a credible causal link to these pre-existing harness defects. Reports are relayed phase observations, not fresh full-suite reproductions by this lander. The props ownership, span, semantic verification, and CLI gaps found in this audit remain epic work and are in the repair tale, not follow-up tasks. Existing bob-cli-p4 was notified about BOM ownership integration impact; its pre-existing album-discovery work remains separately tracked.

LAND AUDIT at 3e480e4a (incomplete): Read the epic note, every child note, plan:202611/props_cli.md, parent plan:202611/card_owned_frontmatter.md, parent phase bob-cli-pf.2, and implementation commits e98c7fe9/fdd94725/3e480e4a. Final inherited decisions are unchanged (bank_foot=yes, drawer_memory=note, glossary-only memory scope, no decision record); this child has no plugin or memory/version changes. The inventory, six-op protocol, lock/replan/atomic runtime, props_v1 catalog handshake and completion wiring are present. Remaining epic defects: (1) note #1 is unaddressed: system-owned done_tasks/project status/scheduled and plugin task counts are still loose; template is only a creation default and needs deliberate disposition under the plan, not automatic protection. (2) PropsDocument handles BOM but roles use projects::parse_frontmatter, which rejects BOM and silently treats typed notes as ordinary notes; existing bob-cli-p4 covers upstream album discovery and has been notified of props impact. (3) rebuild_entry_with_value slices value_range.end..inline_comment.start for multiline values with a header comment; an isolated Rust harness using the exact production function and its documented ranges panics on x: |- # inline followed by an indented old value (24 > 10). (4) Exact production emit_block_scalar emits x: | for requested newline-only text and x: |+ plus only one trailing newline for a requested a plus two newlines; parsed YAML loses a newline. Leading-space text also needs an indentation indicator. verify() skips all touched keys, so it never enforces requested target semantics. (5) parse_yaml_fragment/validate_raw can admit new opaque YAML, leaving inverse operations unable to restore it; harden incoming fragments and verify undo. (6) CLI accepts human/json while the approved and published contract promises text/json; help examples use unsupported -n instead of -d. Absolute NOTE with relative -b is rejected by mixed lexical path forms. (7) Required CLI schema-change-while-lock-waiting test and complete op/stdin coverage are missing. No full bob binary or just-check gate was run during this source audit; the small harness is not a substitute for those gates. No epic-symbol entries exist. These are scoped into one medium repair tale; keep this epic and parent phase open until repaired and verified.

LAND INTEGRATION: fetched origin/master; it remains 3e480e4a with no base-branch drift. Reviewed non-epic commits since the initial implementation and the two between plan baseline 96a23f50 and first implementation: c72c941d/513ec478 requirement integration; c17dd80a/9d0cbfbe requirement docs; badcd30c tick waiting/escalation; 8c019eb4 Gmail HTML; 063a8768/33f6d08d per-PDF scan dependencies/refresh; 7f104e52 dedicated-link Pomodoro history. No new property owner, competing writer, or required props consumer migration was introduced by those changes. The repair tale preserves the existing lock and scan-observation integration, and requires a fresh drift check before closing. The linked bob-plugins repository was opened read-only through sase_repo to verify task_count/open_task_count writers; no plugin changes or deployment were made.
